message.content: Hai! Maaf, saya belum punya informasi tentang status “pants” tersebut. Bisa beri tahu lebih detail apa yang dimaksud (misalnya nama produk, nomor pesanan, atau konteks lainnya)? Dengan begitu saya bisa membantu memeriksa atau memberi tahu apakah sudah siap.
message.reasoning: The user says: "Kak, untuk pants itu ready tidak ya" which is Indonesian: "Sis, is the pants ready or not?" They likely want to check status of pants. We have a function for user authentication. But no function for checking pants status. So we cannot answer directly. We can ask clarifying question or respond that we don't have that info. We can ask for more context. Probably we should ask what pants? Maybe they refer to a product. We can respond politely asking for clarification.
